title: ProtST: Multi-Modality Learning of Protein Sequences and Biomedical Texts

layout.note: Four panels split by dashed black lines: (a) large at top-left, (b) under it, (c) at top-right, (d) under (c); every panel reads left to right from input boxes through trapezoid models to a result at the right.

lesson: Show a multi-use model as one rich pre-training panel followed by small downstream panels that redraw only the changed path, keeping one colour per modality on the input boxes, models, embeddings and arrows so each block is recognised in every panel.
